nodes.label: clApproveQCF - PUT /pr/cl/approve-qcf/{qcf_number}
nodes.rationale: Category Lead approval of a QCF, flagged '**Important**' because it is a side-effecting boundary: items are marked qcf_approved = true, vendor status updates are sent, and SAP Auto PO synchronization is triggered. This makes it the irreversible hand-off point from procurement review into SAP PO creation. Body carries an optional cl_comment. Bearer secured.

hyperedges.label: Category Lead approval gate (read pending, then approve)
